params.body:
## What

The right side of the team's header held seven things: Ask, Studio ↗, gentells.com ↗, a divider, the time, Refresh and Sign out. At 1440px Studio ↗, gentells.com ↗ and Sign out each broke over two lines; at 1280px Sign out fell off the bar. Ask was the one item on the bar without an icon.

- **Ask** has an icon like every page on the bar: a speech bubble with a question in it (Testers keeps the plain bubble).
- **The time is the refresh button**: the arrow and the time of the newest data on the page, "syncing" while it loads. One control where there were a timestamp and the word Refresh; its name for a screen reader and a test is still "Refresh".
- **Signing out and the way to gentells.com sit under the person's first name**, with the e-mail address at the top of that menu; Escape or a click elsewhere closes it. A member of gentells.com keeps gentells.com ↗ on the bar: it is their way back.
- Nothing on the bar wraps any more (`white-space: nowrap` on the tools).

The pages in the middle and the phone layout are unchanged.

## Checked

- `e2e/header.spec.js`, new: at 1280px every control on the team's right side is one line and inside the window; Ask has its icon and opens the drawer; Refresh shows a time; gentells.com and Sign out are not on the team's bar but in the menu, Escape closes it, and Sign out ends the session; a member keeps gentells.com ↗ on the bar and Sign out in the menu. Against the old header it fails on "Studio ↗ broke over two lines".
- The whole e2e suite: 84 of 84. Lint unchanged at 43 (the same as main; the changed files are clean). `vite build` passes.
- Looked at as the team at 1440 and 1280, as a member at 1280, at 390 wide, and the icons at 3x.
params.title: The header's right side fits on one line: Ask gets its icon, the time is the refresh, signing out sits under the name
